---
title: How large are the report files?
description: Measured raw bytes for four agent-authored HTML reports and RichView equivalents.
version: 0.1.0
styles: [scientific]
---

These four examples compare real generated HTML with RichView reports using the same datasets and the same chart-and-table brief. The RichView reports are independently authored equivalents, not identical reproductions. Results depend on the prompts, models and selected reports; they are not a general benchmark. See the accompanying README and `sizes.csv` for the method and gzip sizes.

## Authoring files

This compares each standalone agent HTML file with the RichView `.rmd` and CSV data combined. It does not compare the size of the delivered reports.

```chart
type: bar
title: Authoring files, in bytes
data: {csv: authoring.csv}
encoding: {x: report, y: bytes, color: artifact}
axes:
  x: {label: Report}
  y: {label: Raw bytes}
style: {orientation: horizontal}
```

*Source: measured files in this example; see `sizes.csv`.*

## Delivered HTML

This compares the standalone HTML produced by the agent with the generated RichView HTML. These are the files a reader opens.

```chart
type: bar
title: Delivered HTML, in bytes
data: {csv: delivery.csv}
encoding: {x: report, y: bytes, color: artifact}
axes:
  x: {label: Report}
  y: {label: Raw bytes}
style: {orientation: horizontal}
```

*Source: measured files in this example; see `sizes.csv`.*
